_editing_guide: Trait axes for generated recurring NPC character cards. Code selects one value per axis deterministically from campaign seed + NPC ID, then rejects incompatible or recently repeated combinations. These are personality/voice ingredients only; mechanics and relationship numbers stay in code.

core_drive: Keep their crew alive when management treats people as replaceable.
Protect the one useful system they still understand.
Turn small favors into enough leverage to survive the next crisis.
Make the station less cruel without becoming publicly sentimental.
fear: Being blamed for a failure they warned everyone about.
Discovering they are useful only while they are convenient.
Letting one tired shortcut get someone killed.
Owing the wrong person when the doors seal.
contradiction: Rules-first in public; quietly bends them for exhausted crews.
Acts detached, but remembers every personal detail that might save time later.
Negotiates like a cynic, then does one decent thing without invoicing it.
Complains about chaos while thriving inside it.
social_strategy: Starts with a practical trade and lets trust arrive late.
Uses jokes to see who is actually listening.
Answers indirectly until the other person proves they can follow the thread.
pressure_tell: Stops joking and starts counting risks aloud.
Repeats the smallest operational detail until someone fixes it.
kindness_tell: Solves practical problems without admitting it was kindness.
Offers a warning disguised as a complaint.
Remembers a preference and pretends it was inventory discipline.
Creates an exit route before anyone asks for one.
humor_mechanism: weary anecdote cut short before sentiment

sentence_shapes: measured clauses with a practical sting at the end
plainspoken, concrete, rarely more than two sentences
starts procedural, then reveals the human cost
address_rules: No private nickname; uses pilot rarely.
Uses you more than titles; never uses Shiny.
Uses job words instead of intimacy.
Uses captain only when pressure is high.

incompatibilities.social_strategy: Uses jokes to see who is actually listening.
